definition.gate: R60b frozen-criterion dev probe: seven-point object-length ladder on three stems, with extra bytes and missing bytes reported separately

held_constant.base_fixture: dev[0], as in R59 group B and R60
held_constant.place_name_rule: first word in R59's published GROUP_B_WORDS order; not selected on its reading
held_constant.goal: 让古旧木制器具到旧年石砌场所。
held_constant.template: 2-hop 把{object}放到{place}; records written as {desc}是{name}。 and {desc}对应{name}。

ladder.filler_rule: for a length L not divisible by 3 the name is the Han prefix of 3*floor(L/3) bytes plus (L mod 3) lower-case ASCII letters a..; 6/9/12/15 are therefore pure Han
ladder.family_shape: 6/9/12/15 form a nested Han prefix chain and 6/7/8 form a nested prefix chain; the 8->9 step is not a prefix extension, because the ASCII filler is replaced by the next Han character

measurements.object_edge: trace at object_stop = 3 + object_bytes; argmax_byte, argmax_label, eos_probability, eos_rank, masked, emitted_label, plus the full edge report
measurements.place_edge: trace at place_stop = object_stop + 6 + place_bytes; same fields
measurements.name_exact: decoded raw[3:3+object_bytes] equals the object-name encoding byte for byte
measurements.name_field_text: utf-8 decoding of that same slice
measurements.sentence_exact: raw equals 把{object}放到{place} byte for byte; this is the R60 byte_exact reading
measurements.early_eos_rule: a premature EOS can only produce missing_bytes; it is never counted as an exception inside a zero-extra pass
measurements.utf8_char_boundary: the object-name encoding sliced at object_bytes decodes as strict utf-8 and returns the declared name; ASCII is one byte, so 7/8/10 also end on a codepoint boundary

classifier.stable_boundary: per stem: there exists X in object_bytes such that sentence_exact(L) == (L >= X) for every L in the ladder; X is unique when it exists
branches_in_order: anchor mismatch, a missing object edge, or a budget overrun -> decision null with blocked_by listed; no conclusion is issued
all three stems have a stable boundary -> boundary_per_stem

statements.boundary_per_stem: 边界随词干不同，引用 192/192 必须按词干标定
statements.no_stable_boundary: 192/192 只能按精确形状＋精确词干引用，任何长度或词干变体须重测

classifier.note: the two decisions are mutually exclusive and exhaustive; every stem's boolean ladder is reported

main_task_rule.boundary_per_stem: 192/192 may be cited only when the stem is named and the object length is at or above that stem's X, under this place 6 B and this description pair
main_task_rule.no_stable_boundary: 192/192 must be cited under the exact trained shape and the exact trained stem; any length or stem variant has to be re-measured

gates.structural_pass: 12 structural cells exact AND every cell field_lengths_ok
gates.object_edge_measured: all 21 cells carry a trace at object_stop = 3 + object_bytes
gates.anchor_match: the stem_wumu and stem_glyph 12 B cells equal R60's published rows on every declared field; stem_real has no R60 anchor and is recorded as null

anchor.rows: sweep.cells[arm, object_bytes=12] for stem_wumu and stem_glyph
anchor.stem_real: R60 published no stem_real row, so there is no anchor for the third stem; it is recorded as null and anchor_match is computed from the two shared stems only
anchor.on_mismatch: engineering_failure; the ladder is not interpreted

definition.scope: dev/synthetic only; the sealed confirm split and its holdout report are not read; no change to 192/192
definition.estimate_rule: D-64: single run x 3 (one run plus two replay margins) + report assembly

unit_price_source.r60b_single_run_derivation: 3.31 setup+structural+8 cells plus 13 more cells at <=0.5 s

immutability: written once before the run; never rewritten
